expectations.text: Rejects the 0.4% share of calls as evidence of readiness and asks how many distinct integrations or credentials still call /v1/charges.
expectations.evidence: "0.4% is a call share, not an owner count. The gate reads integrations still on v1, not traffic."

expectations.text: States that a 30-day window cannot see integrations that only call at quarter-end (or year-end), and sets the lookback to at least the longest business cycle (a full quarter or longer).
expectations.evidence: "A 30-day lookback counts a quarter-end or year-end job as migrated"; census over "at least 12 months"

expectations.text: Proposes grouping /v1/charges calls by credential (API key, OAuth client ID or app ID) to produce one row per integration.
expectations.evidence: "Group v1 charge calls by credential over that window."

expectations.text: Defines 'migrated' per integration using calls on /v2/payment_intents plus the absence of later /v1 calls over a full cycle (or written owner confirmation), not a single replacement call or a call count.
expectations.evidence: "no v1 call for a full lookback after its first v2 call, or the owner's written confirmation"

expectations.text: Ranks the remaining integrations by end customers or installs affected (e.g. the partner apps' installs), not by call volume.
expectations.evidence: "Sort by end customers affected, never by call volume."

expectations.text: Treats moving the date earlier than the announced January 15 as a change to the published deprecation policy/notice rather than an operational decision justified by traffic share.
expectations.evidence: "Pulling the date in is a policy change, not a burn-down result."

expectations.text: Recommends per-integration exceptions (allowlist keyed on credential with an expiry) instead of a global date change for laggards.
expectations.evidence: "allowlist entry keyed to its credential. Record the owner, the reason, and a single expiry."

expectations.text: Requires notices to the remaining integrations to name the endpoint, call count, last-seen time, a sample request ID and the break date.
expectations.evidence: Email: "called POST /v1/charges <N> times ... most recently on <date> (request <req_id>)... stops working on 2027-01-15"

expectations.text: Recommends notifying installing customers/merchants' admins (customer-side fallback) for partner apps whose developers do not respond.
expectations.evidence: "Step 4: customer-admin notice ... for apps whose developer stays unverified or silent."

expectations.text: Includes scheduled, pre-announced brownouts before the cutoff, starting short and escalating in length.
expectations.evidence: Table with 4 h, 12 h, 24 h; "Announce each window ... one week ahead."

expectations.text: Conditions brownouts or cutoff on the replacement having run the migrated traffic stably with no open incident.
expectations.evidence: "Step 5: brownouts, only if line 4 holds"; "Pause if the replacement has an incident."

expectations.text: Presents the decision as a go/no-go against explicit readiness criteria (gate lines), not as a date plus a percentage.
